title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 36 ]

items.text: He cannot be poor to buy the car.
To do his best, he could not succeed.
He must be rich to marry her.
He must have been rich to marry her.
He had to be rich to marry her.
This juice is for you to drink.
A man to raise the fund must be employed.
Monks have the ability to raise money for food and clothing.
This is the only place left for us to go.
She has an unshakable belief in her right to govern Pakistan.
She rose to deliver a 40 minute speech.
The president might use his constitutional power to dismiss the parliament.
He was selling TV sets at cost to get rid of an overstock.
They are to go to the polls in national elections.
He was never to return home.
